CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFREGISTRY

CFREGISTRY works with the registry, the tree of keys and values where Windows keeps its settings. KoldFusion for UNIX brings its own registry, stored in REGEDIT4 format in registry/kf.registry under the install directory; it holds the server settings and anything your applications put there.

Category

File, directory and system

Syntax

<CFREGISTRY ACTION="GetAll" BRANCH="branch" NAME="query_name" TYPE="data_type" SORT="criteria">
<CFREGISTRY ACTION="Get" BRANCH="branch" ENTRY="key_or_value" VARIABLE="variable" TYPE="data_type">
<CFREGISTRY ACTION="Set" BRANCH="branch" ENTRY="key_or_value" TYPE="value_type" VALUE="data">
<CFREGISTRY ACTION="Delete" BRANCH="branch" ENTRY="key_or_value">

Attributes

ACTION
Required. GetAll (list the entries of a key), Get (read one value), Set (create or change a value or subkey) or Delete (remove a value, or a whole key).
BRANCH
Required. Full name of the key, such as HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Allair\KoldFusion. HKLM is accepted as short for HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE.
NAME
Required for GetAll. Query that receives the entries, with the columns Entry, Type and Value.
ENTRY
Required for Get and Set; optional for Delete. The value (or, for Set with TYPE="Key", the subkey) to work on. Delete without ENTRY deletes the key named by BRANCH.
VARIABLE
Required for Get. Variable that receives the value. A missing value gives an empty string.
TYPE
Optional, default "String". For GetAll: String, DWord, Key or Any (which entries to list). For Set: String, DWord or Key.
VALUE
Optional. For Set, the data to store.
SORT
Optional. For GetAll, columns to sort on, such as "Entry ASC".

Usage

For compatibility with templates written for ColdFusion on Windows NT, any branch that mentions SOFTWARE\Allaire\ColdFusion is quietly redirected to SOFTWARE\Allair\KoldFusion, so the old scripts that peek at the server's settings keep working.

The registry is shared by the whole server, including the Administrator. Writing to the wrong key can break your data sources or settings; keep your own data under a key of its own. Restricting the tag is possible on the Basic Security page of the Administrator.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Branch = "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Allair\KoldFusion\Snippets">
<!--- Create a subkey with two values --->
<CFREGISTRY ACTION="Set" BRANCH="#Branch#" ENTRY="Demo" TYPE="Key">
<CFREGISTRY ACTION="Set" BRANCH="#Branch#\Demo" ENTRY="Greeting" TYPE="String" VALUE="Hello, registry">
<CFREGISTRY ACTION="Set" BRANCH="#Branch#\Demo" ENTRY="Visits" TYPE="DWord" VALUE="1999">

<CFREGISTRY ACTION="GetAll" BRANCH="#Branch#\Demo" NAME="Entries" TYPE="Any" SORT="Entry">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Entry</TH><TH>Type</TH><TH>Value</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="Entries">
<TR><TD>#Entry#</TD><TD>#Type#</TD><TD>#Value#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>

<CFREGISTRY ACTION="Get" BRANCH="#Branch#\Demo" ENTRY="Greeting" VARIABLE="Said">
<CFOUTPUT><P>Get returned: #Said#</P></CFOUTPUT>

<!--- Clean up: remove the whole Demo key --->
<CFREGISTRY ACTION="Delete" BRANCH="#Branch#\Demo">
<CFREGISTRY ACTION="GetAll" BRANCH="#Branch#" NAME="Left" TYPE="Key">
<CFOUTPUT><P>Subkeys left under Snippets: #Left.RecordCount#</P></CFOUTPUT>
